── MARISOL'S WEEK ──
Marisol is training for a second marathon, the Wexley Lakes Marathon, aiming to break 3:45 after a 4:02 debut. Marisol runs five days a week, with a session on Wednesday, the long run on Sunday and Monday and Friday off, and ran about 30 miles a week before this build.
Recent weeks: 53, 40, 42, 46 mi
This week: 34 mi over 5 runs.
Body: "Legs heavy and flat. Nothing hurts, they just feel dead."
Feeling: "Nervous. I feel like I'm losing fitness."
Asks: "Is it crazy to do one more 16-miler on Wednesday so I feel ready?"

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Marisol: Keep the week light and focus on recovery so you arrive ready to hit your sub-3:45 target.
Answers: No, adding another 16-mile on Wednesday would break the taper. Keep the mileage low, use a short easy with strides, and rest on Thursday and Saturday.
Next week:
Mon: rest
Tue: easy, 4 mi, keep heart rate under 150, flat route. Looses legs.
Wed: easy, 3 mi, 4 strides, keep heart rate under 150, fresh legs.
Thu: rest
Fri: easy, 4 mi, short recovery run, keep effort low.
Sat: rest
Sun: race, marathon, keep target pace, stay hydrated, focus on form.
